caption: Kar. 76. Stela
reading: wos : wetdyinoq?e(2)l?i : q?ri : wetrri ẖ?(3)i?d?n?sedkesywi : bero(4)[.]dtpote : terikelowi : (5)yi w?l? d?tei?l?ḫ : tedḫe(6)lowi : ato : mẖe : psos?e(7)kete : at : mẖepsiḫ(8)rkete : ḫmlolw : p(9)sol?kete
notes: Copy in 5 rows that do not match the stone lines; row breaks fall after 'wetrri' (no divider, joined here with a space), after 'terikelowi' (a single dot read as divider), after 'tedḫelowi :' and after 'psos?ekete :'. Names in rows 1-3 uncertain. '/3' (slash + 3) is q or o+s in 'noq?e' and 'q?ri' (in Kar. 77 'asoreyi' the same pair is s+o). The sign written '/' + 4 with a bar is read te throughout (terike-, tedḫe-, -kete); context may want t in tedḫe. ꭓ/ϰ forms read d (tedḫe) but could be ñ elsewhere (wetd?yi, d?te, the d after the dotted sign). Row 2: a sign drawn in dots with a solid long tail after (4) = [.]. 'psos?e': two 3-shaped signs around a slash after p, second could be q (/3). In 'ḫmlolw' the last sign looks like w (closed loop), no i visible; 'at : mẖe' has no divider between mẖe and psiḫrkete. The ς between o and k in the last word is small (l?) or e.

notes: Rows of the copy are not stone lines. No divider at the row break after 'terikelowi' (space here). Row 2 'ḫdḫd?i?i?y?e' unsure: λ-shaped signs read d, cluster '44' after it unclear, a hatched stroke in the y. Row 3 'd?k(4)r?et?r?i?' largely hatched; first sign a Z-shape (d? ñ?). 'sml?d?y?i?' hatched in part. Row 4 'pese?toak?id?te': ب with dot = to, '52' = a; the 3 with long tail after a read k (could be n). Row 5: 'altered' stretch of about four overwritten signs read l?o?l?o? (as in beloloke); a dotted connector before it is not counted; Λ with long tail read n. Row 6: bold 2-shape with long tail read k (could be n or a). Row 7: the to in 'ato' is hatched; the sign after p(8) is a bold 3 (s?), then a hatched te; one hatched lost sign after p(9)s... read [.] where formula has i. Row 8: the sign after ḫ is a V with three dots above (shape b; context m).
